svg.aria-label: Two browser clients submit concurrent edits to one Figma document process, which orders the accepted edit and sends canonical state back over WebSockets.
svg.text: One owner orders every document edit.
Clients edit optimistically; one process validates changes and broadcasts canonical state.
Same property: later accepted edit wins
ordered update fans back over WebSockets
One document. One owner. One ordered history.
Illustrative same-property conflict; see the article for protocol details and modeled costs.
